$description: FileInput (platform/components/FileInput, library wave 6, lane A): its component tokens. The button is a secondary Button (its own tokens); the Remove buttons are ghost Buttons.

file-input-gap.$description: FileInput: the space between the button and the line that says what is chosen.

file-input-row-gap.$description: FileInput: the space between the button row and the file list.

file-input-summary-text.$description: FileInput: the line beside the button (No file chosen, 3 files) and each file size: secondary text.

file-input-summary-font-size.$description: FileInput: the size of the line beside the button.

file-input-name-font-size.$description: FileInput: the size of a file name and its size in the list.

file-input-data-font-family.$description: FileInput: file names and sizes are technical values, in the data font (Reddit Mono).

file-input-list-gap.$description: FileInput: the space between the files in the list.

file-input-item-gap.$description: FileInput: the space between a file row’s icon, name, size and Remove button.

file-input-item-min-height.$description: FileInput: the height of a file row (the inline action’s height, its Remove button).

file-input-icon-size.$description: FileInput: the file icon at the start of a row.
